changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RollupPath') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[RollupPath] ( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ScoreType] [int] NOT NULL, [State] [int] NOT NULL, [PathHash] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NULL ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricRollupPath') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPath] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricRollupPath] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricRollupPath') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPath] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricRollupPath WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
